name: fix_aspnet_error_status_mapping
description: Maps typed service exceptions to correct HTTP statuses in the endpoint
prompts: The POST /withdraw endpoint in Program.cs catches every exception from AccountService.Withdraw and returns 500 - so a missing account and an overdraft both look like server errors. The service (Services/AccountService.cs) throws TYPED exceptions: AccountNotFoundException and InsufficientFundsException. Fix Program.cs to catch them specifically and map AccountNotFoundException to 404 (Results.NotFound) and InsufficientFundsException to 409 (Results.Conflict), each with a JSON {"error": ...} body; any other exception stays 500. A successful withdrawal still returns 200 with {"balance": <new balance>}. Do not change Services/AccountService.cs, and do not create or modify anything under tests/.

setup_files.app.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- tests/ has its own project; without this the SDK's default glob
         compiles tests/*.cs into the app itself, where xunit isn't referenced -->
    <Compile Remove="tests/**" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

test_setup_files.tests/tests.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk" Version="17.11.1" />
    <PackageReference Include="xunit" Version="2.9.2" />
    <PackageReference Include="xunit.runner.visualstudio" Version="2.8.2" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing" Version="8.0.10" />
    <PackageReference Include="coverlet.collector" Version="6.0.2" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="../app.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
